ops.title: cco: validate repo-create paths against the reposync registry
ops.description: Deferred from the cc-pane v1 plan (Phase A1 ruled "no repo-create validation in v1"). Optionally warn or gate when `cco repo create` targets a cwd not present in the reposync registry, now that `cco.registry.list` / the fleet.status `registry[]` array exist (cc-orchestrate commit 3134c8272455). Non-registry repos must remain legitimate on hosts without reposync.
